column1: # RNA classes of the built-in mouse references (GRCm39, built 2026-10-08); same BED labels as human.
# Columns: docker/scripts/refTables.py. Release 0.3.0. Ranks = parseMappings genetype_hierarchy of 0.2.x, with rank 10
# for labels it did not list; groups = qcReport TYPE_GROUPS of 0.2.x; gene_table = collapseGenes DROP/EXCLUDE of 0.2.x.
# Step S2: class ids and display names from the 0.3.0 translation map (miRNA-pre -> pre-miRNA,
# unannotated -> genome_unannotated, RiboSpike-Short -> RiboSpike-Fragment, Unmapped -> unmapped). Rows that share a
# class id agree on its class-level columns (display_name, group, display_order, positions, gene_table, counts_as_rrna).
# Step S3a: the star arm (label miRNA-star, star tier) is class miRNA (TERMINOLOGY_REVIEW Q3, option b); its rank stays 10.
# Step S3b: snRNA and snoRNA reads get _5p/_3p/_internal/_whole like tRNA (positions = yes; Q11 option b).
# Step S3g: reads on UniVec contigs are the class UniVec (before: part of unannotated; TERMINOLOGY_REVIEW Q8).
# Step S4 (report): groups protein_coding (was mRNA; RealSeq review #8), "genome: pre-mRNA, pre-tRNA" and "genome (unannotated)" (were one group "genome, precursors, introns"; #9).
